points.statement: The work aims to restore varied degradations within one unified framework.
points.quote: All-in-one image restoration aims to handle diverse degradations within a unified framework.

points.statement: It builds a structured degradation state using simplex-constrained archetype mixture modeling.
points.quote: construct a structured degradation state through simplex-constrained archetype mixture modeling

points.statement: It generates degradation-aware prompts to better condition decoder channels.
points.quote: generates degradation-aware prompts to improve channel-wise conditioning in the decoder

points.statement: It pushes degradation-aware and complementary features toward orthogonal response subspaces to reduce spatial interference between removal and preservation cues.
points.quote: regularizes degradation-aware and complementary features toward orthogonal response subspaces
